g0.description: Items are created in the server's “Catalogue” tab.

tradingEnabled.label: Allow members to trade items
tradingEnabled.help: Lets members give each other items. Turn it off if the economy matters: a freely circulating rare item routes around the shop, and alt accounts become storage chests.

drops.label: 🎁 Loot from mini-games
drops.description: Drops “droppable” items at the end of mini-games (RPS, tic-tac-toe, battleship), with a percentage per rarity. Rolled from the rarest to the most common.

enabled.label: Enable drops
enabled.help: Makes items drop from mini-games. Only items flagged « droppable » in the catalogue can fall: with not one item so flagged, turning this on produces nothing.

on.label: When to roll a drop

winDraw.label: On a win or a draw

on.help: Which game outcomes earn a roll. « Win only » rewards playing well; « any game » rewards running the command, which gets noticed fast.

common.label: % drop — Common (0-100)
common.help: Chance, in per cent, that a common item drops. The roll goes from the rarest tier down and stops at the first success: this is the last one tested. 0 = never.

rare.label: % drop — Rare (0-100)
rare.help: Chance that a rare item drops, tested before commons. 0 = never.

epic.label: % drop — Epic (0-100)
epic.help: Chance that an epic item drops, tested before rares. 0 = never.

legendary.label: % drop — Legendary (0-100)
legendary.help: Chance that a legendary item drops. It is tested first, so it wins: raising it to 100 means nothing but legendaries will ever drop.

sell.label: 🗑️ Quick sale back to the server
sell.description: Lets a member sell an item back to the server with /sell: the item is destroyed and the member gets a percentage of its shop price.

enabled.label: Enable the quick sale (/sell)
enabled.help: Lets a member destroy an item for part of its price. It is the escape hatch for a full inventory — and the only way to take an item out of circulation.

percent.label: % of the price paid back on a sale (0-100)
percent.help: The share of the shop price paid back on sale. Must stay well under 100: at 100, buying then selling is free, and the item has no cost. Above that, you are minting money on demand.
